admission.justification: Guarded by clause_title fallback tests and prevents unreadable six-word truncated rule headings in briefs that obscure what legacy invariants require.

applicability: Display title selection in file briefs and read_ar_files short answers for legacy invariant records lacking a stored title field.
conditions: Returns stored titles after whitespace normalization unchanged.

For untitled statements, keeps normalized statements <= 80 characters whole, cuts longer ones at the first sentence separator (. , ? , ! ) in characters 20-80 without ellipsis, else at the last clause separator in 20-80 with ellipsis, else at the last word boundary up to 80 characters with ellipsis.
Never mutates the underlying stored invariant record.
exclusions: Does not waive the requirement that newly authored invariants carry an explicit one-line title of at most 80 characters.
statement: Untitled invariants derive a non-mutating readable fallback title from their first sentence or clause up to roughly 80 characters instead of blind 6-word truncation.
title: Untitled invariants derive non-mutating ~80-char first-clause titles
